PREMIUM QUALITY MATERIALS - Our glass tumblers are made with a lead-free process, guarantee the safety of your family and friends with lead-free glasses that pose no threat. No harmful chemicals, compounds, or materials can be found in any of the classic drinkware. At the same time, they have impressive durability, ensuring no chips, cracks, or breaks from daily use.

HIGHLY VERSATILE - This glass set is perfect for Water, juice, wine, martinis Juice, Beer, Cocktails, and more. Unique and beautiful designs make them the perfect addition to your home, outdoor dining table.
GORGEOUS GIFT SET - These glassware sets make a wonderful holiday, Christmas, or housewarming guests to friends, family, or new neighbors who love hosting.
AFTER-SALE SERVICE - If you receive chips, cracks, or breaks glass, please send email to contact us or directly replace it, we guarantee to be responsible for all quality problems.
